note: The chapter opening (P01 'CHAPTER 12', the title passage P02 and the two introductory paragraphs P03, P04) has no heading in the supplied list (which starts at 12.1), so subtopic 1 carries from_heading 'unsure'. Section 12.4 is a long block with no sub-headings and carries five separable ideas (thermodynamics, producers/consumers/food chains, detritus food chain, trophic levels and standing crop, the ten per cent law), so those subtopics were split by content and share one from_heading. The grazing food chain is first named in the truncated tail of P22, which also covers carnivores, so P22 sits with the producers/consumers/food-chain subtopic while P23-P24 cover the detritus food chain and the GFC/DFC comparison. Figure passages P15 and P30 have empty text and are placed with the text immediately preceding them. The summary passage P37 is attached to subtopic 1; the exercise passage P38 (visible blanks on producers fixing carbon dioxide and on pyramid shapes) is attached to subtopics 10 and 14.
